title: MySQL 8.4 innodb_buffer_pool_size calculation warning
author: external_dba
body:
Hello,
On MySQL 8.4.0-LTS running on Ubuntu 22.04 with 64GB RAM,
MySQLTuner outputs:
[!!] InnoDB Buffer Pool size is 12GB (< 70% of RAM).
However innodb_buffer_pool_instances is set to 8.
Config:
innodb_buffer_pool_size = 12884901888
max_connections = 500
Can you please advise?

title: Deprecated query_cache_type detected on MySQL 8.0
author: legacy_migrator
body:
Upgraded from 5.7 to 8.0.36. In my.cnf I still have:

query_cache_size = 0
MySQLTuner warned about query cache. Is this expected?
